C1778.title: OTA Update Process Vulnerable to Man-in-the-Middle Attacks and Firmware Spoofing
C1778.summary: SEA-ME's Secure OTA project builds a security design and self-assessment checklist for automotive OTA update workflows, covering OTA servers, networks, in-vehicle central gateways, and target ECUs. The README lists man-in-the-middle attacks, impersonated OTA servers, rollback attacks, malicious firmware updates, and unauthorized access as risk scenarios, and recommends TLS/SSL, PKI, digital signatures, hash protection, version checks, and anomaly detection.
